description:
Title: Car Service

The police has a new app to remind you of your car service.
The process is started after a successful service.
When a service is necessary, the system checks if your car is still registered.
If it is registered, you are notified.
If you do not go to the service, you are fined after 30 days.
At the car service facility the mechanic enters the problems of your car for reference.
While you wait (can take several days), you get status updates via email.
You can pay through the app, when the repair is done.
The mechanic enters that the repair was successful and you got your "Pickerl".
The mechanic enters the time for you next service.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_CarService" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/car-service">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_ServiceCompleted" name="Service completed"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_CarBrought" name="Car brought to service"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_ServiceDue" name="Service due notification"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_StatusUpdate" name="Repair status update"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Payment" name="Payment via app"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_CarService">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_PoliceApp" name="Police Reminder App" processRef="Process_PoliceApp"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_CarOwner" name="Car Owner"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_CarService" name="Car Service Facility" processRef="Process_CarService"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_ServiceDueNotification" name="Service due notification" sourceRef="SendTask_NotifyOwner" targetRef="Participant_CarOwner"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_CarBroughtToService" name="Car brought to service" sourceRef="Participant_CarOwner" targetRef="StartEvent_CarBrought"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_StatusUpdate" name="Repair status update" sourceRef="SendTask_StatusUpdate" targetRef="Participant_CarOwner"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Payment" name="Payment via app" sourceRef="Participant_CarOwner" targetRef="ReceiveTask_Payment"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_ServiceCompleted" name="Service completed" sourceRef="EndEvent_ServiceCompleted" targetRef="StartEvent_ServiceCompleted"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_PoliceApp" name="Police Reminder App" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_ServiceCompleted" name="Service completed">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_ServiceCompleted" messageRef="Msg_ServiceCompleted"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CheckRegistration" name="Check if car is still registered"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Registered" name="Car registered?"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NotRegistered" name="Car not registered"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_NotifyOwner" name="Notify car owner that service is due" messageRef="Msg_ServiceDue"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_OwnerVisitsService" name="Car owner brings car to service within 30 days"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_VisitInTime" name="Visited within 30 days?"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_VisitRecorded" name="Service visit in time"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_IssueFine" name="Issue fine to car owner"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Fined" name="Owner fined"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToCheck" sourceRef="StartEvent_ServiceCompleted" targetRef="Task_CheckRegistration"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckToGateway" sourceRef="Task_CheckRegistration" targetRef="Gateway_Registered"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Registered" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Registered" targetRef="SendTask_NotifyOwner">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${carRegistered}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotRegistered" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Registered" targetRef="EndEvent_NotRegistered">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${!carRegistered}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotifyToVisit" sourceRef="SendTask_NotifyOwner" targetRef="Task_OwnerVisitsService"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_VisitToGateway" sourceRef="Task_OwnerVisitsService" targetRef="Gateway_VisitInTime"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InTime" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_VisitInTime" targetRef="EndEvent_VisitRecorded">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${visitedWithin30Days}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotInTime" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_VisitInTime" targetRef="Task_IssueFine">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${!visitedWithin30Days}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FineToEnd" sourceRef="Task_IssueFine" targetRef="EndEvent_Fined"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_CarService" name="Car Service Facility" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_CarBrought" name="Car brought to service">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_CarBrought" messageRef="Msg_CarBrought"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterProblems" name="Mechanic enters car problems for reference"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RepairSplit" name="Start repair and status updates"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_RepairCar" name="Repair car"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_StatusUpdate" name="Send repair status update email" messageRef="Msg_StatusUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RepairJoin" name="Repair and status updates done"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="ReceiveTask_Payment" name="Receive payment via app" messageRef="Msg_Payment"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterRepairSuccess" name="Mechanic enters successful repair"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_IssuePickerl" name="Issue Pickerl to car owner"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterNextService" name="Mechanic enters time of next service"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ServiceCompleted" name="Service completed">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_ServiceCompletedEnd" messageRef="Msg_ServiceCompleted"/>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToProblems" sourceRef="StartEvent_CarBrought" targetRef="Task_EnterProblems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ProblemsToSplit" sourceRef="Task_EnterProblems" targetRef="Gateway_RepairSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToRepair" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairSplit" targetRef="Task_RepairCar"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToStatus" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairSplit" targetRef="SendTask_StatusUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RepairToJoin" sourceRef="Task_RepairCar" targetRef="Gateway_RepairJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StatusToJoin" sourceRef="SendTask_StatusUpdate" targetRef="Gateway_RepairJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JoinToPayment" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairJoin" targetRef="ReceiveTask_Payment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PaymentToSuccess" sourceRef="ReceiveTask_Payment" targetRef="Task_EnterRepairSuccess"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SuccessToPickerl" sourceRef="Task_EnterRepairSuccess" targetRef="Task_IssuePickerl"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PickerlToNextService" sourceRef="Task_IssuePickerl" targetRef="Task_EnterNextService"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NextServiceToEnd" sourceRef="Task_EnterNextService" targetRef="EndEvent_ServiceCompleted"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
